items.headline: Finastra launches cloud SBLC tool for banks
items.summary: Finastra rolled out StandbyX, a SaaS platform letting regional and mid-sized banks automate standby letter of credit processing without deploying a full trade finance system, per Trade Finance Global.

items.headline: PCI Energy deal stirs ETRM consolidation debate
items.summary: Industry analysts at CTRM Center are questioning whether Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of PCI Energy Solutions is reshaping valuation and consolidation expectations across the ETRM vendor landscape.

items.headline: Dry bulk routes shift on grain, iron ore moves
items.summary: A weekly commodity freight briefing flagged reduced Russian and US wheat export availability, Saldanha iron ore loading delays after rail maintenance, and firmer US soybean and corn export activity reshaping bulk carrier deployment.

items.headline: FIA pushes for simpler EMIR 7d reporting
items.summary: FIA submitted comments to ESMA on its proposed EMIR Article 7d reporting framework, advocating a targeted, proportionate approach to avoid duplicative derivatives reporting for commodity market participants.
